title: The trainer loop: stake, host the daily window — ours only at launch; the reward class is designed
intro: Press play to walk the flow one step at a time, or click a dot to jump.

walk.title: Stake 1K KAT
walk.text: The operator bond for hosting a window — designed for third parties; the stake machinery matures first. Local models stay optional and unarmed (measured quality + latency fail; a reopen bar is on record).

walk.title: The daily window
walk.text: One container, cron-start, sleep-after — billing is the run window only. The LLM lane is API-first with free legs and a USD cap. It runs today on our replicas only, and the page says so.

walk.title: Endorsements (a designed class)
walk.text: Trainer endorsements plus an epoch pool share — the reward class settles when third-party hosts open; until then nothing is promised. v1 windows are fleet-funded from the USD treasury.
